messages:
alex: Heads up — ACME reporting high latency + 5xxs since 10:12 UTC. Dashboard shows EU requests briefly routed to us-west for ~30m, then heartbeat flapped and triggered failover to ap-south. Customer seeing request timeouts and a billing spike. Logs below.

ops-bot: alert: probe-failure eu-west -> us-west failover count=14 window=3m alert_id=pf-2026-03-02-71

maria: Can you paste the probe logs and the route name? Any 401s or token errors? Also confirm if their usage/ingress looks normal — worried about billing.

alex: Logs (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-02T10:11:58Z] probe eu-west -> routed_to=us-west status=200 latency=28ms
[2026-03-02T10:12:03Z] probe eu-west -> routed_to=us-west status=502 latency=12ms
[2026-03-02T10:12:08Z] probe eu-west -> timed out after 1500ms
[2026-03-02T10:12:13Z] probe eu-west -> routed_to=us-west status=502
[2026-03-02T10:12:19Z] failover triggered -> new_region=ap-south reason=probe_flap
```
Repro I ran:
```bash
for i in $(seq 1 20); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{remote_ip} %{time_total}\n" -H "X-Region: eu-west" https://api.redwood.example/v1/predict; sleep 1; done
```
Output shows intermittent 502s and remote_ip resolving to us-west IPs.

jordan: Sounds like routing chose a compatible fallback (us-west) when eu-west probe showed transient failures. If probes are noisy we get false-positive failovers. What's our failover config? TTL/cooldown?

sam: FYI we had TTL=10s and immediate flip on 3 failures. That's aggressive for noisy probes. Temporary mitigation: apply route pin for ACME `route_override=eu-west` and increase probe window to 30s / require 2 consecutive failures across 3 probes. I'll push a canary change in 5m. :thumbsup:

maria: Please also flag billing team — cross-region egress could inflate charges. Support: proactively message ACME with ETA and offer a credit if their bill spiked due to our failover.

alex: Tagging steps I used to repro and logs attached. Not seeing auth errors; tokens look fine. @sam please proceed with the override and report back.

sam: Applying override now to the ACME route (canary). Will monitor metrics and probe traces. If RTTs return to baseline we'll revert the failover and mark the probe agent flaky.

jordan: I'll open a PR to change the failover policy: add 20s cooldown and require 2 out of 3 failed probes within a 60s window before triggering. Also adding extra logging to probe agent to include path/machine-id.

alex: Thanks team — I'll update the customer thread and keep monitoring. :pray:
